### 2026-10-24 – # The finish line.

**0.02h**

# The finish line.

I completed the project!

I did all of the artwork on the pcb, the firmware, and the repo readme. I got some artwork from claude to use on the front side of the pcb, i gathered the inspo and also wrote the prompt. I read through some documentation and wrote the firmware in Arduino IDE with Pico core and tiny usb midi, along side some more essential imports.
